scope: Initial controlled POCs; no app/package/runtime settings changed. Candidate artifact pins/licenses come from the merged research inventory.

targets.readiness: Explicitly distinguish initial startup, already-ready warm, first use after idle, and forced-fresh recovery.
targets.memory_policy: Simultaneous desktop+all owned ASR/cleanup working sets plus shared GPU memory; dedicated VRAM and private commit separately; do not subtract presumed overlaps.

runtime_reference.name: llama.cpp
runtime_reference.note: Current Freehand manifests are CPU-only. Windows GPU POCs require different complete verified runtime artifacts and positive worker telemetry.

cpu_start_profile.batch_note: 128/128 is a proposed measurement point, not a proven optimal value.
cpu_start_profile.prompt_policy: Specialists use exact prescribed system/control/template. No generic JSON envelope unless their trained contract permits it. General controls use a frozen minimal editing policy.
cpu_start_profile.output_policy: Allow enough room for complete utterance, validate EOS/stop vs length, never truncate or silently chunk to manufacture a fast score.
cpu_start_profile.literal_policy: Run native-contract diagnostics and separate actual Core dictionary integration. Existing opaque IDs are a condition to validate, not presumed supported by a new model.

initial_pocs.purpose: Exact trained contract, compact context, independent cost/quality baseline.
Individual one-factor subtrials q8_0 KV; no-repack; context1024vs2048; batch256/128; threads2vs4. Never change all at once and attribute savings to one factor.
Full layer/KV offload attempt, real backend/device/telemetry, ASR plus cleanup together.
requirements: verified GPU runtime archive and complete inventory

initial_pocs.purpose: Ready alternative quantized implementation, not engine-only equivalence experiment.
requirements: no main-app ONNX dependency change beside sherpa runtime
explicit prepared ModelPath and no automatic acquisition
validate known integration guards and complete-output contract
retain original S1 NOTICE plus derivative license evidence

verify exact published artifact and supported chat contract

initial_pocs.candidate: best faithful measured candidate from P1-P7
initial_pocs.purpose: Compare no-extra-model ngram-simple or ngram-mod target-verified speculation.
requirements: compare exact greedy returns and semantic review
record acceptance lengths and cost rather than assume speedup

measurements: input and output token counts and full raw model returns
provider-restored candidates, final Core results, fallback reasons and accepted coverage separately
semantic fidelity and complete/partial/missed cleanup on already-normalized baseline
hash time, load/readiness, template/tokenization, prefill/decode and complete delivery where observable
simultaneous all-owned-process RSS/working set, private resident/commit, shared and dedicated GPU gauges
context/checkpoint/cache/model/compute allocations where source/runtime exposes them
cold start, ready warm, idle reuse, unique-prompt retention growth, teardown/cancellation/worker recovery
CPU/GPU device, power/performance state, OS/driver/backend versions, ASR contention, thermal conditions
go_no_go: No accepted meaning-changing edit on protected cases; report uncertainty and finite-test limits.
Do not count code-restored bytes, fallback or merely answering a question as cleanup success.
Full normalized dictionary semantics, literal bytes/order, one delivery maximum, complete-response validation and original recovery preserved.
No final production selection from isolated model/RSS or first-token results; joint actual Windows app must pass its declared cost policy.
Missing/invalid GPU telemetry invalidates GPU proof.
License ambiguity, unsupported backend/input contract, repeated incomplete returns or high bypass rate blocks claimed completion.
holdout_policy: Previously inspected90case corpus and30heldout are now development/regression/validation. Freeze selected candidate+all settings before a fresh untouched holdout. A revision after observing its failures needs fresh finalholdout; do not relabel reused cases independent.
not_established: Any small candidate meets all quality and SLA requirements.
Any specific cache/repack setting caused the earlier9.7GiB peak.
Any Windows GPU or NPU inference performance from this Linux research.
Any new bound on user microphone accuracy or physical delivery.
